thread:
nina: Quick PSA  I'm prepping a small tidy-up PR to the Optimize migration docs: add a concise note about prefetch compatibility with q4 quant profiles, plus two copy-paste SDK snippets and one-line troubleshooting steps. Keeping it minimal so support can paste it.

ash: Can you paste the exact snippets you plan to include? Makes review faster.

nina: Sure, will include both JS and Python. JS snippet: 

```js
// safe short-prefix preset for q4_fast
await client.optimize.update({
  model: 'redwood/q4-fast-v2',
  batching: { strategy: 'microbatch', maxBatchMs: 10 },
  cache: { prefetch: { enabled: false } }
});
```

Python snippet: 

```py
# safe short-prefix preset for q4_fast
client.optimize.update(
  model='redwood/q4-fast-v2',
  batching={'strategy': 'microbatch', 'max_batch_ms': 10},
  cache={'prefetch': {'enabled': False}}
)
```

leo: Add a one-line Console path so support can point customers: Console > Optimize > Pipeline > Caching > Prefetch (toggle). Also include a short decision bullet: short-prefix -> prefetch=false; long-stream -> prefetch=true.

nina: Added. Plan to create `docs/optimize/migration/prefetch-compatibility.md` and an example folder `examples/optimize/prefetch-tidy` with a smoke script. I'll attach perf job 2537 as an artifact.

ash: Can you also add a tiny troubleshooting checklist with thresholds? e.g., "If you see p95 first-token > 200ms, try prefetch=false and microbatch 5-15ms." Keeps it actionable.

nina: Yep, that exact wording. I'll also suggest marking the examples-smoke CI as flaky-tolerant and assert p95_first_token < 180ms after warmup for the short-prefix preset.

infra-bot: Reminder: any example that touches timing should set `CI_FLAKY=true` in the job matrix and upload CSV artifact.

leo: One more nit: avoid saying "bug" in the docs. Phrase as "observed first-token latency with grouped-attention q4 variants; recommended mitigation."

nina: Good catch. Will phrase it that way. Branch name: `docs/prefetch-compat-tidy-3087654321`. Labels: `docs:optimize`, `needs-ml-review`, `examples`.

ash: Once you open the PR, please link the smoke run artifact and add the perf graph. I'll do a quick ML review and check the example behavior.

docs-bot: PR created: https://git.redwood/repo/docs/pull/3560 by nina  labels: docs:optimize, needs-ml-review, examples.

nina: Thanks bot. I plan to merge after 1 ML + 1 Docs sign-off. After merge I'll post a short note in #eng-ml and backport a single-line pointer to the Optimize migration index.

leo: If it lands today, can we also add a changelog bullet under Optimize v2 migration? Small entry: "Prefetch guidance for q4-family quant profiles."

nina: Will add that to the PR description. Closing loop here  ping me on the PR if you want wording tweaks.
